broker.name: GO Markets
broker.tagline: On its own site since 2006. Its site names ASIC, CySEC, and FSC (Mauritius). Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:500.
broker.about: GO Markets says it has operated since 2006. An address it publishes is Melbourne, Australia. Account names on its site include Standard (Australia page), GO Plus+ (Australia page), Micro (Australia page), Standard (international / Mauritius page), GO Plus+ (international / Mauritius page), Micro (international / Mauritius page), GO Professional, and Swap-free Islamic account. Platforms named there include MT4, MT5, cTrader, TradingView, and GO TradeX. The site names these regulators: ASIC, CySEC, and FSC (Mauritius). The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:500. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. ASIC: GO Markets Pty Limited, AFSL 254963. CySEC: GO Markets Ltd, 322/17. FSC (Mauritius): GO Markets Pty Ltd (MU), GB 19024896.

broker.costs_note: Spreads and commissions move with the market, and they are not the same at every company in the group.

leverage.note: Both FAQs say retail clients can trade with up to 30:1. Australia Standard and GO Plus+ cards also say up to 30:1.
Both FAQs say wholesale clients can trade with up to 500:1. The EU FAQ calls the higher category Professional in one answer and wholesale in the leverage answer.
Standard, GO Plus+ and Micro cards say leverage up to 500:1.

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

other_fees.label: Minimum deposit
other_fees.note: Australia FAQ and EU FAQ both say there is no minimum deposit to open a live account. The Australia FAQ also says traders often start with $200, which is not stated as a minimum. The Micro account on the Australia and international account pages lists Minimum Deposit $10 USD. Standard and GO Plus+ cards on those pages do not show a minimum. Because the stated figure is not the same on every page, no single minimum is recorded.

other_fees.label: Deposit fee
other_fees.value: None charged by GO Markets for listed methods
other_fees.note: Australia FAQ: no deposit fees for Visa/Mastercard, PayPal, Skrill, Neteller or bank transfer. EU FAQ lists Visa/Mastercard, PayPal, Skrill, Neteller or bank transfer the same way.

other_fees.label: Withdrawal fee
other_fees.note: Australia FAQ: no withdrawal fee. Non-Australian banks may charge their own intermediary fees. EU FAQ says the same for non-Australian banks.

other_fees.label: Margin call and stop-out
other_fees.note: Stated on Australia and EU FAQ pages.
